stage: T5 settled: model-specific tokenization, durable billing reservations with crash reconciliation, and fail-closed spending ceilings
summary: Context accounting now tokenizes the complete visible request with the route's model-specific tokenizer (o200k_base for o-series/4o/4.1/5, cl100k_base for GPT-4/3.5 and as a labeled approximation for families without a public tokenizer, legacy encodings for completion models), always behind an explicit envelope margin with the accounting method naming the encoding. Every Expert and ordinary-session model dispatch holds a durable reservation on the governed experts:billing:v1 ledger before the provider is called and settles from provider-reported usage or its full conservative amount. Deterministic reservation ids make crash recovery collide with the interrupted reservation: the interrupted entry is booked conservatively as reconciled-unknown (never zero) and the recovery re-dispatch proceeds under a separately booked generation, so no usage is dropped, double-counted or blindly repeated; boot reconciliation settles open reservations from committed invocation evidence and books the unestablishable as unknown. Operator ceilings (settings.changeSpending: ordinary-session and global USD) refuse over-ceiling and unpriced dispatch before any provider call, and the Experts panel shows the live ledger through the new public experts-billing projection.
